study_identification_part.si_4_title: Comprehensive volumetric phenotyping of the neonatal brain in Down syndrome

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to model the development of absolute and relative tissue volumes in the control sample from 32 to 46 weeks PMA at scan.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to model the development of absolute and relative tissue volumes in the control sample from 32 to 46 weeks PMA at scan. ... GPR is a Bayesian non-parametric regression method that provides a point estimate of the average volume and measures of predictive confidence for every observation, whereas accounting for modeled covariates.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: FukamiGartner2023.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Normative modeling using Gaussian process regression

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study modeled Intracranial volume (ICV), Total brain volume (TBV), Total tissue volume (TTV), Total cortical GM, Total deep GM, Total WM, and various specific tissue segments including regional GM/WM, cerebellum, brainstem, hippocampus, amygdala, and CSF-filled volumes (eCSF, lateral ventricles).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: T2-weighted images were segmented into seven main tissue/fluid classes: extra-cerebral cerebrospinal fluid (eCSF), lateral ventricles, cortical GM, WM, deep GM, cerebellum, and brainstem ... Cortical GM, deep GM, and WM were further automatically segmented into the specific tissue segments listed in Table 1.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: FukamiGartner2023.pdf.md: Materials and methods / MR image segmentation

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model (GPR) accounted for sex and age variables. When extracting z-scores for the DS group, the model accounted for sex, PMA at scan, and age from birth.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to model the development of absolute and relative tissue volumes in the control sample from 32 to 46 weeks PMA at scan. ... accounting for modeled covariates. ... Subsequently, the GPR model was used to extract individualized absolute and relative volume z -scores ... for an independent sample of 25 neonates with DS, accounting for sex, PMA at scan (in weeks), and age from birth (in weeks) variables.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: FukamiGartner2023.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Normative modeling using Gaussian process regression
